documents.title: Account security
documents.content: A signed-in member can replace an MFA device from Settings > Security > Multi-factor authentication. If the member has lost every authentication factor, the workspace owner must approve recovery. Support cannot disable MFA without owner approval.

documents.title: Document formats and limits
documents.content: Document search accepts PDF, Markdown, and plain-text files. Each file may be at most 20 MB. Password-protected PDFs are not supported.

documents.title: Data retention
documents.content: Uploaded documents are deleted 30 days after their workspace is deleted. Audit exports are retained for 90 days. Workspace owners may request earlier deletion of uploaded documents.
